name: Yuzu
siboNotes: Yuzu juice and zest are well-tolerated for most SIBO patients as citrus fruits are typically low in fermentable compounds.
preparationTips: Use yuzu zest sparingly as it's very aromatic and flavorful
Fresh yuzu juice can be stored in refrigerator for up to 1 week
Bottled yuzu juice is available if fresh yuzu is unavailable
A little goes a long way - yuzu has an intense citrus flavor
